Name: Mine Changes
Author: JPANv2
Description:
Ever thought that there isn't enough ore and gems on the mines? Wish the mine spawned Geode Nodes? Monsters are too few or too many for your tastes? Then this mod is for you!

Mine Changes is a mod that allows you to configure a lot of details to your mining experience. It does so through a complex Config file that is divided into roughly five sections
[list]
[*]The mapLayout section allows you to control how many stones, monsters and items spawn, as well as the gem spawn rate and boulder spawn rate;
[*]The stoneChances section allows you to control default stone choice generation, such as ores and gems, as well as mystic and purple stones
[*]The breakStone section allows you to add chance for drops to specified stones
[*]The stoneReplacements section allows you add a chance to replace certain stones into new stones (such as the Geode nodes)
[*]The itemReplacements section allows you to add a chance to replace certain floor items (such as quartz) with new items.
[/list]
The mod supports JsonAssets Objects in most objectID fields, meaning you can even spawn modded items on your mines or make them drop from the stones you break.

This mod is open sourced, and available on Github [url=https://github.com/JPANv2/Stardew-Valley-Mine-Changes/]here[/url]﻿. I here grant permission to modify or update this mod if I'm unable.[url=https://github.com/JPANv2/Stardew-Valley-Mine-Changes/]
[/url]
